title: Order fulfilment queue with carrier selects and ship/print-label actions
notes: v1 renders each row's carrier picker as a <pw-carrier-picker> web component with a declarative shadow root; v2 (emotion CSS-in-JS) flattens it to a light-DOM <select> with regenerated id/name and reworded options, moves the app header into a <pw-app-header> shadow root, splits the queue into 'Ready to ship' / 'Awaiting stock' tbodies sorted by a new 'Ship by' column, reorders Destination/Items, turns 'Print label' into an icon-only button, renames 'Ship' to 'Mark as shipped', moves the bulk buttons into a bulk-action bar, and adds a hidden mobile card list plus a hidden mobile bulk bar that duplicate every action. The table id survives, so positional selectors now hit the wrong order.
